debugCenter.sessionDescription: Confirms your login session is valid, checks your two-factor assurance level, and does a live read-your-own-row test against Row Level Security.
debugCenter.sessionEmptyDescription: Click "Run Checks" to verify your session, MFA level, and RLS access.
debugCenter.realtimeDescription: Opens a live Supabase Realtime channel and confirms it actually reaches a subscribed state -- the deeper check behind the plain HTTP reachability test on the Connectivity tab.
debugCenter.realtimeEmptyDescription: Click "Run Checks" to open a test realtime channel.
debugCenter.performanceDescription: Hardware capability, current memory usage, and a live network throughput test.
debugCenter.performanceEmptyDescription: Click "Run Checks" to read device specs and measure network speed.
debugCenter.historyDescription: Every Connectivity check you've run, persisted -- trends over time instead of just what's happening right now.
debugCenter.noHistoryCheckedDescription: Click "Refresh" to load your recent diagnostic runs.
debugCenter.noHistoryDescription: Run a Connectivity check to start building history.

team.title: My Team

team.leadOnly: This page is only available to designated team leads.
team.noTeammates: No other employees found in your department yet.
team.punctualityDescription: On-time rate across each teammate's full attendance history, not just today.

fleetHealth.title: Fleet Health
fleetHealth.subtitle: Aggregated edge-device diagnostics across everyone's attendance scans — inference speed, network/battery conditions, camera clarity.
fleetHealth.supervisorOnly: This page is only available to supervisors.
fleetHealth.noSnapshots: No device health data reported yet.
fleetHealth.perDeviceDescription: Same sessions, grouped by employee -- see exactly which device is dragging the fleet average down.
fleetHealth.issuesDescription: Only sessions that reported a reduced model tier, a slow network, or an obstructed lens.
fleetHealth.noIssues: No flagged issues in any reported session.
